# BR-500 Control Narrative: pH and Dissolved Oxygen Control

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Document | CN-BR500-PHDO (number TBD by document control) |
| Revision | A, draft for review |
| System | DeltaV BPCS, GMP |
| Equipment | BR-500, 2000 L single-use CHO bioreactor |
| Scope | pH control module (AIC-501) and DO control module (AIC-502) |

**Basis note.** BR-500 is a batch unit, so these modules use ISA-88 control-module states inside the batch phases. ISA-106 does not apply. ISA-5.06.01 structure and ASD-STE100 wording still apply.

**Reading convention.** Every number is in the parameter list (§2.2). Parameters with status "Confirm" are provisional. Validation must not execute OQ against a "Confirm" value until Process Sciences releases it (OI-01). Each requirement has an ID and an OQ test method, so one requirement maps to at least one test case.

---

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

AIC-501 keeps culture pH at setpoint. It adds CO2 to lower pH and sodium carbonate base to raise pH. AIC-502 keeps dissolved oxygen at setpoint. It increases agitation first, then air, then oxygen.

| Interface | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Batch executive (ISA-88 phases) | In | Phase state: Media Fill, Equilibrate, Inoculate, Production, Harvest. Recipe setpoints. |
| Batch record | Out | Base total, setpoint change records, mode changes, alarms. |
| Agitator SIC-530 | Out | DO cascade writes the speed setpoint. Media Fill and Harvest phases own SIC-530 outside the control window. |
| Base bag and WT-521 | In | Base mass for the per-batch base limit. |
| Gas MFCs FCV-510/511/512 | Out | Flow setpoints. |
| Bag pressure, exhaust filter, temperature, level, feeds | None | Out of scope. Separate narratives. See OI-05. |
| Probe calibration and offline standardization | None | Out of scope. Covered by QC SOP. See OI-12. |
| SIS | None | No SIS function is assigned to these modules. If HAZOP assigns one, the SRS governs. See OI-06. |

## 3. States and transitions

### 3.1 Control window

pH and DO control are active from Equilibrate start through Production end. Outside the window, both modules are INACTIVE.

| Batch phase | AIC-501 | AIC-502 | SIC-530 owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Media Fill | INACTIVE | INACTIVE | Media Fill phase |
| Equilibrate | Active | Active | AIC-502 cascade |
| Inoculate | Active | Active | AIC-502 cascade |
| Production | Active | Active | AIC-502 cascade |
| Harvest | INACTIVE | INACTIVE | Harvest phase |

### 3.2 Module states (same structure for AIC-501 and AIC-502)

| State | Outputs | Entry permissive | Initiator | Automation level | Allowed exits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| INACTIVE | Inactive positions, §3.4 | None | Automatic | Automatic | AUTO (T-01) |
| AUTO | Controller calculates outputs, §4 | Phase in control window. Selected PV valid. AIC-502 only: SIC-530, FIC-511, FIC-512 in cascade. | Activation sequence or operator | Automatic | MANUAL (T-02), FAULT (T-04), INACTIVE (T-06) |
| MANUAL | Operator sets OP | Phase in control window, or controller restart (T-07) | Operator or restart | Manual | AUTO (T-03), INACTIVE (T-06) |
| FAULT | Fault positions, §8 | None | Automatic | Automatic shed | AUTO (T-05), MANUAL (T-05), INACTIVE (T-06) |

### 3.3 Transitions

| ID | From → To | Condition | Initiator |
|---|---|---|---|
| T-01 | INACTIVE → AUTO | Activation sequence SEQ-01 step 4 | Automatic |
| T-02 | AUTO → MANUAL | Operator selects MANUAL | Operator |
| T-03 | MANUAL → AUTO | Operator selects AUTO and AUTO entry permissive is true | Operator |
| T-04 | AUTO → FAULT | Selected PV invalid (§8.1), or AIC-502 cascade element leaves cascade | Automatic |
| T-05 | FAULT → AUTO or MANUAL | Operator selects mode. AUTO requires the AUTO entry permissive. | Operator |
| T-06 | Any → INACTIVE | Phase leaves the control window, phase STOPPING or ABORTING, or SEQ-02 | Automatic |
| T-07 | Any → MANUAL | Controller restart while the phase is in the control window (§8.4) | Automatic |

A batch HOLD does not change the module state. The cells need pH and DO control while the batch is held.

### 3.4 Inactive positions

| Element | Inactive position |
|---|---|
| P-520 | Stopped |
| FCV-510 | Zero flow |
| FCV-511 | Zero flow |
| FCV-512 | Zero flow |
| SIC-530 | Released to the owning phase at current speed |

### 3.5 State requirements

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR-001 | AIC-501 and AIC-502 are INACTIVE in Media Fill and Harvest. | Run each phase. Verify module state and inactive positions on the faceplate and the device feedback. |
| FR-BR-002 | In INACTIVE, the module rejects operator mode changes. | In Media Fill, try to select AUTO and MANUAL. Verify rejection and an operator message. |
| FR-BR-003 | AIC-501 and AIC-502 go to AUTO through SEQ-01 at Equilibrate start. | Start Equilibrate. Verify T-01 for both modules. |
| FR-BR-004 | A batch HOLD in Equilibrate, Inoculate, or Production does not change module state or outputs. | Hold each phase with modules in AUTO. Verify state unchanged and control continues against a simulated PV step. |
| FR-BR-005 | Phase STOP or ABORT puts both modules in INACTIVE. | Stop, then abort, a Production phase in separate runs. Verify T-06 and inactive positions. |
| FR-BR-006 | The module enters AUTO only when the AUTO entry permissive is true. | Make each permissive false in turn. Try T-03. Verify rejection. |
| FR-BR-007 | MANUAL to AUTO and FAULT to AUTO are bumpless. | Set OP in MANUAL. Select AUTO. Verify OP starts from the manual value with no step. |
| FR-BR-008 | The module does not return from FAULT to AUTO without operator action. | Force FAULT. Clear the cause. Verify the module stays in FAULT until the operator selects a mode. |
| FR-BR-009 | Phase transitions from Equilibrate to Inoculate and from Inoculate to Production do not change module state or outputs. | Trend OP and mode across each transition. Verify no change. |

---

## 4. Regulatory control

### 4.1 PV selection (AY-501, AY-502)

A probe is valid when all of these are true:
- The signal status is good.
- The value is inside the validity range (PH-05/PH-06 for pH, DO-04/DO-05 for DO).
- The operator did not set the probe to OUT OF SERVICE.

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-PH-001 | When both pH probes are valid and source is AVERAGE, AY-501 is the average of AT-501A and AT-501B. | Inject two different valid values. Verify AY-501 equals the average. |
| FR-PH-002 | When one pH probe is invalid, AY-501 uses the valid probe and AIC-501 stays in AUTO. | Make each probe invalid by bad status, by each validity limit, and by OUT OF SERVICE. Verify AY-501 and mode. |
| FR-PH-003 | When both pH probes are invalid, AIC-501 goes to FAULT. | Make both invalid. Verify T-04 and fault positions. |
| FR-PH-004 | When the probe difference exceeds PH-07 for PH-09, the system alarms and prompts for an offline sample. AY-501 keeps the current source. | Inject a difference above PH-07. Verify alarm and prompt after PH-09, not before. |
| FR-PH-005 | When the probe difference exceeds PH-08 for PH-09 and source is AVERAGE, AIC-501 goes to FAULT. | Inject a difference above PH-08. Verify FAULT after PH-09. |
| FR-PH-006 | The operator can select source A, B, or AVERAGE. A selected invalid probe causes the same response as FR-PH-003. | Select each source. Verify AY-501. Make the selected probe invalid. Verify FAULT. |
| FR-DO-001 to FR-DO-006 | Same as FR-PH-001 to FR-PH-006, for AT-502A/B, AY-502, AIC-502, with DO-04 to DO-08. | Same methods with DO parameters. |

### 4.2 pH control (AIC-501)

| Item | Specification |
|---|---|
| PV | AY-501 |
| Setpoint | PH-01 from recipe. Operator can change inside PH-03 to PH-04. |
| Action | Direct. PV above setpoint increases OP. |
| Output | Split range. OP 0 % to PH-13: base. PH-13 to PH-14: gap, no acid and no base. PH-14 to 100 %: CO2. |
| Base region | P-520 rate goes from PH-16 at OP 0 % to stopped at PH-13. |
| CO2 region | FCV-510 setpoint goes from range minimum at PH-14 to range maximum (PH-15) at 100 %. |
| Deadband | While AY-501 is within PH-01 ± PH-02, OP does not change. |
| Constraint | Base interlocks I-01 to I-04 override the base region (§6). |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-PH-010 | AIC-501 OP maps to P-520 rate and FCV-510 setpoint per the split range above. | In MANUAL, set OP at each breakpoint and midpoint. Verify P-520 rate and FCV-510 setpoint. |
| FR-PH-011 | P-520 and FCV-510 are never active at the same time. | Sweep OP from 0 % to 100 % and back. Verify no point with both active. |
| FR-PH-012 | While AY-501 is inside the deadband, AIC-501 OP does not change. | In AUTO, hold PV inside the deadband for 10 min. Verify OP constant. |
| FR-PH-013 | When AY-501 is above PH-01 + PH-02, OP moves toward the CO2 region. | Inject PV above the band. Verify OP increases. |
| FR-PH-014 | When AY-501 is below PH-01 − PH-02, OP moves toward the base region. | Inject PV below the band. Verify OP decreases. |
| FR-PH-015 | At activation, AIC-501 OP initializes to PH-17. | Start SEQ-01. Verify OP and that both actuators are off. |
| FR-PH-016 | When a base interlock is active and OP is in the base region, P-520 stays stopped and the controller does not wind up below PH-13. | Activate I-01. Inject low PV. Verify P-520 stopped and OP limited at PH-13. |

### 4.3 DO control (AIC-502)

| Item | Specification |
|---|---|
| PV | AY-502 |
| Setpoint | DO-01 from recipe. Operator can change inside DO-02 to DO-03. |
| Action | Reverse. PV below setpoint increases OP. |
| Output | Sequential split range, in this order. |
| Region 1, OP 0 % to DO-12 | SIC-530 setpoint goes from AG-01 to AG-02. FCV-511 and FCV-512 at zero. |
| Region 2, OP DO-12 to DO-13 | SIC-530 at AG-02. FCV-511 goes from zero to FL-01 maximum. FCV-512 at zero. |
| Region 3, OP DO-13 to 100 % | SIC-530 at AG-02. FCV-511 at FL-01 maximum. FCV-512 goes from zero to FL-02 maximum. |
| Cascade | SIC-530, FIC-511, and FIC-512 are in cascade from AIC-502 in AUTO. |
| Cascade break | If any of these leaves cascade, AIC-502 goes to FAULT (T-04). |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-DO-010 | AIC-502 OP maps to SIC-530, FCV-511, and FCV-512 per the regions above. | In MANUAL, set OP at each breakpoint and midpoint. Verify all three setpoints. |
| FR-DO-011 | FCV-511 flow starts only when SIC-530 is at AG-02. FCV-512 flow starts only when FCV-511 is at maximum. | Sweep OP up. Verify the order. |
| FR-DO-012 | On decreasing OP, the order reverses: FCV-512 first, then FCV-511, then SIC-530. | Sweep OP down. Verify the order. |
| FR-DO-013 | SIC-530 setpoint from AIC-502 is never below AG-01 or above AG-02. | Set OP at 0 % and 100 %. Verify limits. |
| FR-DO-014 | When AY-502 is below DO-01, OP increases. When AY-502 is above DO-01, OP decreases. | Inject PV steps above and below DO-01. Verify OP direction. |
| FR-DO-015 | At activation, AIC-502 OP initializes to DO-16. | Start SEQ-01. Verify OP and output positions. |
| FR-DO-016 | When SIC-530, FIC-511, or FIC-512 leaves cascade, AIC-502 goes to FAULT. | Move each element out of cascade in turn. Verify FAULT and alarm. |

### 4.4 Base addition total (WQI-521)

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BA-001 | WQI-521 resets to zero once per batch, in SEQ-01 step 2 of the first Equilibrate. | Start Equilibrate. Verify reset. Hold and restart Equilibrate. Verify no second reset. |
| FR-BA-002 | WQI-521 increases by each WT-521 decrease divided by BA-03. | Simulate a known WT-521 decrease. Verify WQI-521 volume. |
| FR-BA-003 | WT-521 increases do not decrease WQI-521. | Simulate a WT-521 increase. Verify WQI-521 unchanged. |
| FR-BA-004 | WT-521 decreases count toward WQI-521 when P-520 is stopped. | Stop P-520. Simulate a WT-521 decrease. Verify WQI-521 increase. |
| FR-BA-005 | WQI-521 keeps its value across controller restart. | Record WQI-521. Restart the controller. Verify the same value. |
| FR-BA-006 | WQI-521 does not change during SEQ-03 (bag change). | Run SEQ-03 with a full bag. Verify WQI-521 before and after. |
| FR-BA-007 | The final WQI-521 value goes to the batch record. | Run SEQ-02. Verify the batch record entry. |

---

## 5. Sequences

### SEQ-01: Activation (Equilibrate start)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check permissives: Equilibrate is RUNNING. At least one valid probe for pH and for DO. WT-521 valid. SIC-530 running at or above AG-01. | All true | EQ-04 | Alarm "BR-500 control activation permissive". Hold the phase. |
| 2 | Prompt operator: "Make sure that the base bag is connected and the line is primed. Push CONFIRM." Record WT-521 as reference. Reset WQI-521 (first Equilibrate only). | Operator confirms and WT-521 is stable per BA-06 | EQ-04 | Alarm. Hold the phase. |
| 3 | Load PH-01, PH-02, and DO-01 from recipe. Set AIC-501 OP to PH-17 and AIC-502 OP to DO-16. | Values confirmed in the modules | EQ-05 | Alarm. Hold the phase. Modules stay INACTIVE. |
| 4 | Put AIC-501 and AIC-502 in AUTO (T-01). Put SIC-530, FIC-511, FIC-512 in cascade. | Both modules report AUTO | EQ-05 | Alarm. Hold the phase. Modules go to MANUAL with OP at initial value. |
| 5 | Wait for stable culture conditions. | AY-501 within PH-01 ± PH-02 and AY-502 within DO-01 ± EQ-01, continuously for EQ-02 | EQ-03 | Alarm "Equilibrate not stable". Prompt operator: CONTINUE WAITING or HOLD. |
| 6 | Report "pH/DO equilibrated" to the batch executive. This is the Inoculate permissive. | Report accepted | EQ-05 | Alarm. Equilibrate does not complete. |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-SEQ-001 | SEQ-01 runs each step in order and stops on each failure response as listed. | Execute the normal path. Then force each step failure and each timeout. Verify the response. |
| FR-SEQ-002 | The Inoculate permissive is false until SEQ-01 step 6 is complete. | Try to start Inoculate before step 6. Verify rejection. |
| FR-SEQ-003 | Any excursion outside the stable bands restarts the EQ-02 timer. | Inject an excursion during step 5. Verify timer restart. |

### SEQ-02: Deactivation (Production complete)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Put AIC-501 and AIC-502 in INACTIVE (T-06). Release SIC-530 to the Harvest phase at current speed. | Both modules report INACTIVE | EQ-05 | Alarm. Hold the Harvest phase. |
| 2 | Confirm inactive positions. | P-520 run feedback off. FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 flow PV below FL-05. | EQ-05 | Alarm "BR-500 gas or base not stopped". Hold the Harvest phase. |
| 3 | Write the final WQI-521 value to the batch record. | Write confirmed | EQ-05 | Alarm. Prompt operator to record the value manually. |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-SEQ-010 | SEQ-02 runs at Production complete and gives the listed failure responses. | Execute the normal path. Force each failure. Verify the response. |

### SEQ-03: Base bag change (operator-initiated, Equilibrate through Production)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Operator pushes BAG CHANGE. Stop P-520. Freeze WQI-521. AIC-501 continues on the CO2 side. | P-520 run feedback off | BA-09 | Alarm "P-520 failed to stop". Abort SEQ-03. WQI-521 stays live. |
| 2 | Prompt operator: "Replace the base bag. Prime the line. Push CONFIRM." | Operator confirms | BA-05 | Alarm "Base bag change overdue". Keep P-520 stopped. Keep the prompt. |
| 3 | Record the new WT-521 reference. Unfreeze WQI-521. Release P-520 to AIC-501. | WT-521 stable per BA-06 | EQ-04 | Alarm. Keep P-520 stopped. Prompt operator to repeat step 2. |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-SEQ-020 | SEQ-03 stops base addition, keeps WQI-521, and resumes base addition only after a stable new reference. | Execute the normal path. Verify WQI-521 and P-520 at each step. Force each failure. |
| FR-SEQ-021 | A WT-521 increase during SEQ-03 does not cause the A-BA-04 alarm. | Simulate a weight increase in step 2. Verify no alarm. |

---

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

No cause-and-effect chart was supplied. These rows are the BPCS interlocks for these modules. They are not SIS functions.

| ID | Cause | Effect | Latched / auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-01 | WQI-521 at or above BA-01 | Stop P-520. Base inhibited for the rest of the batch. AIC-501 continues on the CO2 side. | Latched | No reset in this batch. Resets at the next Media Fill start. See OI-04. |
| I-02 | WT-521 invalid | Stop P-520. Freeze WQI-521. | Latched | Operator reset after WT-521 is valid and stable per BA-06. A new reference is taken at reset. |
| I-03 | SIC-530 not running, or speed below AG-01 | Stop P-520. | Auto-reset | Clears after SIC-530 is at or above AG-01 for BA-08. |
| I-04 | P-520 command and run feedback differ for BA-09 | Command P-520 off. | Latched | Operator reset from the P-520 faceplate. |
| I-05 | Phase outside the control window | Modules INACTIVE (T-06). Inactive positions. | Auto-reset | Clears by SEQ-01. |
| I-06 | Both pH probes invalid, or pH deviation above PH-08 on AVERAGE | AIC-501 FAULT: stop P-520, hold FCV-510 at last setpoint. | Latched | Operator mode selection (T-05). |
| I-07 | Both DO probes invalid, deviation above DO-07 on AVERAGE, or cascade break | AIC-502 FAULT: hold SIC-530, FCV-511, FCV-512 at last setpoint. | Latched | Operator mode selection (T-05). |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-IL-001 to FR-IL-007 | Each interlock I-01 to I-07 gives its effect and resets only as listed. | For each row: force the cause. Verify the effect. Try a reset before the reset condition is met, and verify rejection. Then meet the condition and verify reset. |
| FR-IL-008 | In MANUAL, I-01 to I-04 still stop P-520. | In MANUAL with OP in the base region, force each cause. Verify P-520 stops. |

---

## 7. Alarms

No rationalized alarm database was supplied. The alarms below are the alarms these modules need. Priorities are provisional until rationalization (OI-09).

| ID | Condition | Priority | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|
| A-PH-01 | AY-501 above PH-01 + PH-10 for PH-12 | High | Check CO2 flow and probe values. Take an offline sample. |
| A-PH-02 | AY-501 below PH-01 − PH-11 for PH-12 | High | Check base inhibit status and base bag. Take an offline sample. |
| A-PH-03 | One pH probe invalid | Low | Inform maintenance. Plan probe check. |
| A-PH-04 | pH probe deviation above PH-07 | Medium | Take an offline sample. Select the correct probe source. |
| A-PH-05 | AIC-501 in FAULT | High | Take an offline sample. Set AIC-501 to MANUAL or restore a valid probe. |
| A-BA-01 | WQI-521 at or above BA-02 | Medium | Inform the process owner. Prepare the deviation path for base limit. |
| A-BA-02 | I-01 active, base limit reached | High | Inform the process owner and QA. pH can only decrease by CO2. |
| A-BA-03 | I-02 active, WT-521 invalid | High | Check WT-521. Reset I-02 after repair. |
| A-BA-04 | WT-521 increases by more than BA-04 outside SEQ-03 | Medium | Check the base bag and load cell for contact or a liquid return. |
| A-BA-05 | P-520 commanded volume and WT-521 volume differ by more than BA-07 | Medium | Check the base line for leaks or a blocked line. |
| A-BA-06 | I-04 active, P-520 failure | High | Check P-520. Reset I-04. |
| A-DO-01 | AY-502 below DO-09 for DO-11 | High | Check gas supply, agitator, and probe values. |
| A-DO-02 | AY-502 above DO-10 for DO-11 | Medium | Check FCV-512 flow and probe values. |
| A-DO-03 | One DO probe invalid | Low | Inform maintenance. |
| A-DO-04 | DO probe deviation above DO-06 | Medium | Compare with an offline value. Select the correct source. |
| A-DO-05 | AIC-502 in FAULT | High | Find the cause. Restore cascade or a valid probe. Select a mode. |
| A-DO-06 | AIC-502 OP at or above DO-14 with AY-502 below DO-01 for DO-15 | High | Inform the process owner. Oxygen transfer capacity is at its limit. |
| A-FL-01 | FCV-510, FCV-511, or FCV-512 PV differs from SP by more than FL-03 for FL-04 | Medium | Check gas supply pressure and the sparge filter. |

## 8. Abnormal handling

### 8.1 Bad PV

| Condition | Response |
|---|---|
| One probe invalid | FR-PH-002 / FR-DO-002. Control continues on the valid probe. |
| Both probes invalid | I-06 / I-07. AIC-501 stops base and holds CO2. AIC-502 holds all cascade outputs. |
| WT-521 invalid | I-02. Base addition stops. CO2 control continues. |
| MFC flow PV bad | A-FL-01. The controller continues. The flow element holds its last setpoint. |

**Rationale for AIC-501 fault positions.** Stop base because base addition is limited and an overdose cannot be reversed. Hold CO2 because a CO2 stop strips dissolved CO2 and raises pH. See OI-10.

### 8.2 Communication loss

| Condition | Response |
|---|---|
| Workstation to controller | Control continues unchanged in the controller. Other workstations alarm the loss. |
| Batch executive to controller | Modules keep their current state. No phase transition occurs. Alarm. |
| Controller to MFC, P-520, or SIC-530 drive | The device goes to its signal-loss position (§8.3). The point goes to bad status. The related alarm activates. |

### 8.3 Fail positions

| Element | On power loss | On signal loss | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| FCV-510 | Closed | Closed | Confirm (OI-07) |
| FCV-511 | Closed | Closed | Confirm (OI-07) |
| FCV-512 | Closed | Closed | Confirm (OI-07) |
| P-520 | Stopped | Stopped | Confirm (OI-07) |
| SIC-530 drive | Stopped | Hold last speed | Confirm (OI-07) |

### 8.4 Power loss and restart

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-AB-001 | On controller restart in the control window, AIC-501 and AIC-502 go to MANUAL with OP at inactive positions (T-07). | Restart the controller during Production. Verify mode and outputs. |
| FR-AB-002 | After restart, the batch phase goes to HELD and the operator gets the prompt "Controller restart. Check BR-500. Select AUTO for AIC-501 and AIC-502." | Verify phase state and prompt. |
| FR-AB-003 | After restart, WQI-521 and the I-01 latch keep their values. | Restart with I-01 active. Verify I-01 still active and WQI-521 unchanged. |
| FR-AB-004 | If WQI-521 cannot be recovered at restart, base addition is inhibited. A supervisor must enter the value from the batch record to release it. The entry needs a reason (§9.2). | Simulate a lost value. Verify the inhibit, the entry, and the record. |
| FR-AB-005 | On controller switchover (if redundant), module state, outputs, and WQI-521 do not change. | Force a switchover. Trend all values. Verify no change. |
| FR-AB-006 | On loss of signal to each device, the device goes to its §8.3 position and the related alarm activates. | Disconnect each device signal in turn. Verify position and alarm. |
